cleared_risks.description: The signature change to add() is real: src/lib.rs at head now defines `pub fn add() {}` with no parameters or return value. However, a literal search for `add(` in the head commit returned no hits with complete coverage, and the repo has only two files (lib.rs and a toml), so no in-repo caller is broken. Dependents outside this repo could not be checked, and find_symbol was only partially parsed, so this is not a concrete defect demonstrated by the evidence.
cleared_risks.name: add signature changed to no-arg unit function

findings.body:
The change replaces the body of src/lib.rs with `pub fn add() {}` (dropping the u32 parameters and the `a + b` return) and appends a line containing U+FFFD replacement characters before `// tail`. Those characters sit outside any comment or string, so the file no longer tokenizes as Rust.

Trigger: Any build or test of the crate after this change.

Impact: The crate fails to compile, so every build and test of this crate breaks. Any downstream user of `add(a, b)` also fails to compile, because the function now takes no arguments and returns unit.
findings.suggestion: Restore `pub fn add(a: u32, b: u32) -> u32 { a + b }` and remove the stray non-ASCII line.
findings.title: src/lib.rs no longer compiles: invalid characters and add() signature changed

risk_level.reason: The only changed file is src/lib.rs, where the public add function's signature and body are replaced with an empty stub, a breaking API change with a malformed trailing line, and the commit message 'Update lib' gives no rationale.
